title: CARTA Global Constitutional Collection Queue
scope: 193 current UN Member States and two UN non-member observer states. Other ISO country/area records remain separately catalogued and are not included in this sovereign/observer collection denominator.
status_policy: A queue entry is a research assignment, not an assertion that a constitutional text has been acquired, verified, cleared or published.
